text:
sara: RFC follow-up thread. we need a tiny, client-friendly rollout metadata shape so SDKs can resolve pins/aliases cheaply. main goals: compact, monotonic alias binds, explicit retire hints, and predictable cache behavior.
eli: sketching a minimal shape that covers those goals. keep most fields optional:
```
{
  "epoch": "2026-03-02T12:00:00Z",    // opaque token clients can pin to
  "gen": 12,                                // monotonic generation per-tenant
  "source": "control-plane",         // provenance: control-plane|manual|ci
  "aliases": ["stable", "canary-7"],
  "models": ["text-3b@sha256:aa11.."], // optional multi-model list
  "soft_retire_ts": "2026-03-30T00:00:00Z", // advisory
  "hard_retire_ts": "2026-04-15T00:00:00Z", // error after this
  "fallback_order": ["stable", "legacy-fallback"],
  "cache_ttl_s": 30,                         // suggested client cache TTL
  "compat_sig": "sha1:abcd.."            // optional short fingerprint
}
```
jon: +1 to the generation field. clients should treat `gen` as the primary way to detect rebinds (if gen increases, alias may have changed).
kevin: semantics question: is soft_retire a strict deny for alias-based resolves? or just a warning?
eli: intended as advisory. SDKs should emit a warning/log and prefer fallbacks but not hard-block until `hard_retire_ts`.
sara: cache_ttl_s is important. default 30s with jitter/backoff seems fine. include guidance for exponential backoff if metadata endpoint fails.
jon: telemetry: we need alias_resolve_success, alias_resolve_misses, alias_fallback_used, alias_rebind_detected. emit tenant+alias gen in events for debugging.
ops-bot: infra: rollout-metadata svc v2 rolled to canary at 4291234680
kevin: compat_sig should be optional and truncated to avoid huge lists in the client. servers can return full list via admin endpoints.
eli: op note: enforce monotonic binds per-tenant for aliases to avoid flapping. we should document allowed alias semantics (rename vs rebind).
sara: what about ensemble rollouts? models list handles it but SDKs should ignore model refs unless they need them. keep core client contract to (epoch or alias) -> resolve -> epoch token.
jon: security note: require signed metadata for control-plane-originated updates to prevent spoofing; include a `sig:v1` header/proof in API responses.
kevin: action items: (1) eli + sara update draft with `gen`, `source`, and `cache_ttl_s` guidance. (2) ops to add telemetry counters and signing. (3) SDK team to add backoff and warning behavior.
eli: timeline: docs + telemetry by EOD Friday, small Dedicated canary next week.
sara: I'll write the client guidance with examples for `pin: epoch` and `pin: alias` and include retry rules.
jon: sounds good. keep schema minimal and optional fields explicit to avoid client coupling.
kevin: ack. I'll own telemetry and signing work.
eli: thanks all. if no objections by EOD we merge the draft. ping me for a short sync if needed.
